Weekly change SD ≈ 14.6. For a 2-week-ahead forecast with mean reversion, the forecast error SD should be roughly 15-18 — wider than one week's move but narrowed somewhat by mean reversion. An SD of ~16 gives a 2/3 interval spanning about 32 points, consistent with the observed range of weekly swings in this series.
